name: Load Balancing with Replication and Thresholds
aliases: Block assignment algorithm (parallel partitioning and load balancing)
definition: A distributed load balancing strategy for ray casting that uses block replication factors and load balance thresholds to decide between block transfers (moving volume data) and tile transfers (moving projected image data), aiming to minimize communication while maintaining load balance.
summary: Load Balancing with Replication and Thresholds is a distributed strategy for parallel ray casting that uses replication factors and load balance thresholds to minimize communication overhead by prioritizing composition locality over perfect computational balance.
